mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(r.answer_no, a.question_no) as answer_no FROM response_answers r JOIN survey_answers a ON (r.answer_no = a.answer_no) WHERE r.surv_man_no = #{survManNo}

SELECT NVL(r.answer_no, 0) AS answer_no, p.acoount_type FROM response_answers r JOIN survey_people p ON (r.surv_man_no = p.surv_man_no) JOIN survey s ON (s.surv_no = p.surv_no) WHERE p.surv_no = #{survNo}
